contracts.rules: Inward layers and exact SDK owners remain enforced.
Dynamic/type-only imports, SDK ownership, pure core and application effect boundaries.
Release imports limited to stdlib/loguru/pydantic; lint and stub distributions remain dev-only; negative cases required.

checks.expectation: All configured inward and SDK ownership contracts pass.
Architecture tests and injected prohibited dependencies pass.
Release import and dev-only metadata guards reject injected violations.

checks.command: uv run --frozen --no-sync ruff check . && uv run --frozen --no-sync mypy . && uv run --frozen --no-sync vulture
checks.expectation: All static gates pass; separately recorded dead-code and stub misuse controls fail as expected.
Full regression suite passes, including relevant native CPU distributed tests.

checks.command: git diff --check; validate changed Markdown and local links with the documented evidence procedure
checks.expectation: Changed documentation parses, local links resolve, rule inventory matches installed catalog.

documentation: Update docs/static-analysis.md, docs/development.md and specs/026-static-analysis. Runtime contracts, README and GPU guidance retain behavior and need no edits. SciPy/tqdm consumers were inspected and tested; stubs required no source changes.

review.reviewer: acceptance_review (fresh native read-only agent; requested gpt-6.1-sol/high)
review.reconciliation: Reviewed all 41 task-owned paths, including new boundary tests, config/lock, fixtures, encodings, both verifier callers and documentation. Existing inward contracts/effect owners preserved; scoped tooling contracts add negative cases. Unchanged scientific/progress sources are inspected scope only. Main-checkout GPU cancellation edits are excluded. Local uv.sources overrides are environment-only and removed before commits.
